name: The Mourning Promenade
introDiscord:
A marble promenade curves toward the royal ballroom.

Music boxes still play beneath the water while spectral dancers repeat
pieces of celebrations that ended long ago.

Naturally, Shizuki attempted to join.
introTwitch:
A marble promenade curves toward the royal ballroom.

Music boxes still play beneath the water while spectral dancers repeat
pieces of celebrations that ended long ago.

Naturally, Shizuki attempted to join.

the-mourning-promenade-approach.prompt: The Mourning Promenade opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A banquet side table still contains sealed Star Candies arranged like
party favors.

right.message:
A Mourning Courtesan extends one hand.

For a second, this looks like a dance invitation.

Then the duel begins.

Royal etiquette is confusing.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle rests beside dance instructions:

'Step.
Turn.
Twirl.
Hit pillar.
Drink medicine.

I mastered four of five.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

the-mourning-promenade-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Mourning Promenade, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A Courtesan glides across the promenade in perfect rhythm.

You are considerably less graceful.

right.message:
An abandoned musician's chest contains Star Candies among old sheet
music.

forward.message:
A Berry rests beneath Shizuki's dance score:

'Shizuki: 8/10.
Glimmer: 11/10.
Glimmer cannot have 11.

Glimmer refuses correction.'

the-mourning-promenade-threshold.prompt: Near Ballroom Beneath the Tide, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A quiet dressing room contains royal restorative salts.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Courtesan spins beneath the final ballroom arch.

forward.message: A jeweled dance card case contains Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Ballroom Beneath the Tide
boss-antechamber.prompt: The ballroom lights flicker to life one chandelier at a time.

bossPromptDiscord:
The ballroom lights flicker to life one chandelier at a time.

One dancer remains alone at the center of the floor.

The music begins.

Use /yes to accept the final dance or /no to remain safely
uncoordinated.
bossPromptTwitch:

One dancer remains alone at the center of the floor.

The music begins.

Use !yes to accept the final dance or !no to remain safely
uncoordinated.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Ballroom Beneath the Tide. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The music finishes.

The ballroom falls quiet.

Shizuki's scorecard has one final addition:

'Ballroom: ★★★★★

Pillar: rude.'
